newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chinese industrialist drowned in Guiana accident.
newsitem.headline: Chinese industrialist drowned in Guiana accident.

text.p: A Chinese industrialist accidentally drowned while visiting the European space centre in French Guiana, on the northeast coast of South America, the centre said in a communique received in Paris on Wednesday.

Zhang Tong, President of the China Great Wall Industry Corporation, died when he was swept into the sea by a powerful wave while visiting the Salvation Islands, once the notorious disciplinary quarter of France's now-defunct penal colony, the statement said.
Zhang's deputy, Huang Weidong, sought to rescue him but was himself injured in the attempt and had to be rescued by a French sailor, the statement said.
Zhang had been warned of the dangers involved but went to stand on rocks overlooking the choppy island waters to have his picture taken with nearby Devil's Island in the background.

Devil's Island, whose shark-infested waters are surrounded by strong currents and from where no prisoner ever escaped, is best known for the imprisonment there of Captain Alfred Dreyfus, a Jewish officer in the French army who was wrongly accused a century ago of spying for Germany.
